name: 24-7-ai-global
description: 24/7 Global AI — Next.js public marketing site. Deployed on Vercel at 247globalai.com. Editorial dark-luxe brand identity. Hosts the canonical product catalog (`src/lib/products.ts`) of 22 Works in Motion across 4 sections: § 02 Suite (4 shipped products), § 03 Verticals (3 industry apps), § 04 The Lab (10 OSS + in-development entries), § 05 Channels (5 publications). Also hosts `/now` (u-d-b SignalCluster feed) and `/shipped` (u-d-b Deliverable changelog) — both gated by PUBLIC_INTEL_TOKEN env var. This site IS the public taxonomy that other repos reference.

constraints_text: No pushes / tags without explicit operator approval. No --force ever.
src/lib/products.ts is the canonical taxonomy other fleet members reference. Any edits there propagate the public narrative — coordinate with operator before structural changes.
/now and /shipped read u-d-b's public-intel API (token-gated). When that token rotates, this site needs the new value via UDB_PUBLIC_INTEL_TOKEN + UDB_API_URL env vars on Vercel.
Brand identity is editorial dark-luxe per docs/design/BRAND_IDENTITY_V3.md (in character-os) — defer to that lock for visual decisions.
